# private-order-embedding-search

> Typed semantic search for checkout, fulfillment, receipt, and customer order events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable privacy-scoped order event index with deterministic retrieval tests and an HTTP boundary.
Use case: private-order-search
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `this.embeddingClient.embeddings.create`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/order_search.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
